cases.sql: CREATE TABLE enum_partition_rows (m partition_mood) PARTITION BY LIST ((enum_cmp(m, 'ok')))

SELECT partnatts AS key_count, partattrs::text AS attributes, partexprs IS NOT NULL AS has_expression, pg_get_partkeydef(partrelid) AS definition FROM pg_partitioned_table WHERE partrelid = 'enum_partition_rows'::regclass
CREATE TABLE enum_partition_zero PARTITION OF enum_partition_rows FOR VALUES IN (0)
ALTER TYPE partition_mood RENAME VALUE 'ok' TO 'neutral'
ALTER TYPE partition_mood RENAME TO current_partition_mood

CREATE TABLE enum_partition_bad PARTITION OF enum_partition_rows FOR VALUES IN (true)

ALTER TYPE current_partition_mood RENAME VALUE 'neutral' TO 'temporary'
